description: This file defines the ProductImages class, a Java class extending ContentFiles, with a productId property and its accessor methods.

classes.name: ProductImages
classes.description: A class representing product images, extending ContentFiles and associating with a specific product via productId.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with this set of images.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with this set of images.
